summary.title: Detroit | AI Production House in Paris for Luxury Brands

suggestions.title: Make the grid the signature
suggestions.text: Use an irregular product-grid hero with varied tile proportions, compact metadata, and one oversized Novizio statement.
suggestions.why: It directly replaces the reference showreel while preserving its editorial composition and gives Novizio a recognizable product-led entry point.

suggestions.title: Keep color discipline
suggestions.text: Use black, white, grayscale, and one restrained accent only for key actions or pricing emphasis.
suggestions.why: The reference is grounded in a stark monochrome palette, while a controlled accent can help Novizio establish hierarchy without weakening the editorial look.

suggestions.title: Pair display scale with utility text
suggestions.text: Set Novizio headlines at a large editorial scale and use monospace or compact sans-serif labels for product names, prices, categories, and navigation.
suggestions.why: The contrast reinforces the reference’s art-directed feel and makes the product system feel intentional and precise.

suggestions.title: Treat pricing as editorial content
suggestions.text: Present plans as a structured comparison with rules, aligned values, and one highlighted recommendation instead of rounded dashboard-style cards.
suggestions.why: This preserves the reference’s graphic language while making pricing feel native to the design rather than appended as a standard SaaS section.

suggestions.title: Use quiet motion
suggestions.text: Limit animation to short opacity and vertical-entry transitions, staggered grid reveals, and restrained hover feedback.
suggestions.why: The motion profile found no substantial runtime motion machinery, so subtle code-based entrances add polish without contradicting the reference’s static-editorial character.

suggestions.title: Build recurring visual anchors
suggestions.text: Repeat thin dividers, small index numbers, product labels, and oversized whitespace throughout the page.
suggestions.why: These recurring details can connect the hero, product sections, pricing, and footer into one coherent Novizio editorial system.
